name: Metaballs Carousel
description: Full-screen WebGL image carousel where slides transition through a field of noisy, rising metaballs that dissolve the current image into the next, driven by wheel, drag or buttons.
contents: Full-screen WebGL canvas showing a looping set of images
behavior: Mouse wheel and vertical drag move through slides with smooth easing
Metaball blobs rise from a grid and reveal the next image with noise distortion
Prev and Next buttons animate to the adjacent slide
Canvas and image textures resize with the container
Wheel scrolling over the component is captured instead of scrolling the page
editableByProps: Images, labels, background and text colors
Metaball size, grid density, rise distance, drift, easing and noise amounts
Wheel, drag and friction feel, slide duration
Toggle hint, nav buttons, wheel and drag input

needsCodeEdit.where: hover:bg-white hover:text-black classes on the buttons

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blend or edge of the metaballs

needsCodeEdit.where: showHint and showNav blocks in the returned JSX

fixed: Root is h-screen and full width, override with className using an important modifier such as !h-96
Captures wheel events over the component and prevents page scroll while hovered when preventPageScroll is true
Images must allow cross-origin loading (CORS) for WebGL textures
Image textures are prerendered to canvas at container size and rebuilt on resize
